svg.text: A port built in a colossal old wreck, beached and broken in three: the town in its stern, salvage yards round its middle, its bow on a rock with the light.

g.text: the port, in the wreck's stern
sea cliffs, the light on the bow

svg.text: In and out: the wreck is a three-part dungeon of decks, holds
and ladders between open beaches. Tight corridor fights inside,
long open sand outside; gangplanks join the broken sections.
The train runs into the wreck's stern
Port missions in Hulltown and the yards
Win the marker: the Gilded Parlor, stern deck
The launch from the midsection's piers
THE GILDED LILY · THE DECKS WE PLAY
true scale: 180 m long, 24 m across · bow to the right · the launch ties up under the stern; up the ladder onto the aft deck
